# nekoshell

> A Catppuccin terminal rig for macOS: one command installs a zsh config, a prompt, a greeting, a music panel and twenty-four plugins across iTerm2, kitty, Ghostty, Warp and Terminal.app, and one theme switch recolours all of it.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): the front page — install, the commands, the plugins, where every page is
- [Docs index](docs/README.md): every page in this repository, grouped
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the contract for an agent installing or changing nekoshell
- [Install](docs/INSTALL.md): the long install, the commands, upgrading, uninstalling, troubleshooting

## Use it

- [Configuration](docs/CONFIGURATION.md): `nekoshell.toml`, the themes, the prompt, `greet.conf`, `local.zsh`
- [Terminals](docs/TERMINALS.md): what the five adapters can do and what each needs by hand
- [The plugins](docs/plugins/README.md)
